Project concept

About Free Education Assistance

A non-profit educational technology initiative that combines artificial intelligence, social media and personal mentoring to open real pathways into education.

1. Project summary

Free Education Assistance (FEA) is a non-profit educational technology initiative founded by two university students in Germany. The project provides free educational guidance and reliable information to young people — especially students from Afghanistan, refugees, migrants and individuals who face barriers in accessing education.

FEA combines technology, artificial intelligence, social media and personal mentoring to help people discover educational pathways such as scholarships, universities, Ausbildung programmes, free online courses, language programmes and career opportunities. The platform lets people find opportunities, receive guidance, ask questions and connect with a supportive community — in German, English, Dari and Arabic.

2. Problem statement

Many young people have the ability and the will to continue their education, but they do not have access to reliable information or personal guidance.

  • Lack of information about scholarships and educational opportunities.
  • Difficulty understanding foreign education systems.
  • Limited knowledge about university applications.
  • Lack of awareness about Ausbildung opportunities in Germany.
  • Difficulty finding free online learning resources.
  • Language barriers.
  • Lack of support when making educational decisions.

These challenges are especially serious for young people in Afghanistan — including girls and women who face limited educational opportunities — and for refugees and migrants in Germany who need support to continue their education and professional development.

3. Objectives

  1. Provide free educational guidance for students and newcomers.
  2. Increase access to scholarships, universities, Ausbildung and learning opportunities.
  3. Support refugees and migrants in Germany.
  4. Help individuals choose suitable educational and career pathways.
  5. Use technology to make educational information easier to access.
  6. Build an international educational support community.
  7. Provide information in different languages to reach more people.

4. Main activities — the digital platform

We are developing a website that provides free educational information and guidance. The platform includes:

  • Scholarship information.
  • University application guidance.
  • Ausbildung information.
  • Free online courses.
  • German and English learning resources.
  • Application preparation guidance.
  • Career development information.
  • Frequently asked questions.
  • Educational pathways based on users’ interests and backgrounds.

The website is designed to be simple, accessible and understandable for students who may have limited knowledge about international education systems — and it is available in German, English, Dari and Arabic.

5. AI-assisted opportunity analyzer and support system

As software engineering students, we integrate artificial intelligence into the platform to improve access and support. The AI system will:

  • Monitor educational opportunities regularly.
  • Organize scholarships, universities, Ausbildung programmes, internships and free courses.
  • Analyze deadlines, requirements and eligibility criteria.
  • Provide faster answers to common questions.
  • Support users through website chat assistance.
  • Support users through social media chat systems.
  • Provide daily monitoring and assistance to improve user experience.

The AI system works together with human support, so that users receive reliable guidance and practical help — never automated answers alone.

Open the AI Analyzer

6. Social media and digital outreach

To reach young people who need educational support, FEA actively develops its online presence in Germany and Afghanistan across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Telegram and WhatsApp.

We boost our activities, educational campaigns and content visibility so that every student and newcomer can discover our free guidance. We regularly share new scholarships, university opportunities, Ausbildung information, free courses, language learning resources, success stories, guidance videos and application tips.

Reach grows through boosted social activities, regular educational content, search engine visibility, useful updates and an active online educational community.

Instagram Facebook TikTok Telegram WhatsApp

7. Community support

Technology is combined with human support. FEA provides:

  • Online mentoring.
  • Educational webinars.
  • Question-and-answer sessions.
  • WhatsApp and Telegram support groups.
  • Guidance from students and volunteers.
  • Support for individuals planning their educational future.

8. Target groups

Students in Afghanistan

  • Young students searching for international education.
  • Students looking for scholarships.
  • Girls and women who need educational guidance.
  • Students who need information about online learning.

Refugees and migrants in Germany

  • German education pathways, universities and Ausbildung.
  • IT training and free courses.
  • Career development and integration through education.

9. Implementation plan

1

Phase 1

Website and social media development (until October)

Develop the digital foundation: complete website development, prepare educational resources in German, English, Dari and Arabic, prepare the social media platforms, develop the AI support system and organize content.

View the live development version
2

Phase 2

Active launch and project development (from October)

FEA becomes active: publish educational opportunities regularly (scholarships, universities, Ausbildung, free courses), support users through chat and social channels, collect feedback, and increase awareness in Germany and Afghanistan.

3

Phase 3

Physical support centre in Afghanistan

After a successful first three months: establish a physical support centre in Afghanistan to provide direct educational guidance, support students with limited access, and connect young people and girls with international opportunities.

10. Expected impact

  • Help thousands of students access educational information.
  • Increase awareness about scholarships.
  • Support refugees and migrants in Germany.
  • Create a strong educational community.
  • Make education opportunities easier to discover.
  • Reduce barriers caused by lack of information.
  • Help people make better decisions about their educational future.

11. Long-term vision

Create an international educational support network where every person — regardless of nationality, financial situation or background — can access reliable information and guidance to build their future. FEA believes that education creates opportunities, and that access to information is the first step toward achieving them.
